command:
set -euo pipefail
D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-research-organs-rebase.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$D"' EXIT
git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$D/repo"
cd "$D/repo"
H=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
echo MAIN_HEAD=$H
SHAS=$(gh api repos/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein/pulls/94/commits --paginate --jq '.[].sha')
printf 'PR94_COMMITS=%s\n' "$(echo "$SHAS" | tr '\n' ',')"
git checkout -q -b omega-research-organs-probe "$H"
for s in $SHAS; do echo CHERRY_PICK=$s; if ! git cherry-pick -q "$s"; then echo CHERRY_PICK_CONFLICT=$s; git status --short; git cherry-pick --abort || true; exit 23; fi; done
git diff --check "$H..HEAD"
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_research_organs.py tests/test_omega_final_assembly.py tests/test_omega_organ_activity.py tests/test_omega_acoustic_authority_convergence.py tests/test_voice777_installer_convergence.py
python3 scripts/omega_runtime.py self-test 2>/dev/null || true
echo PROBE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo OMEGA_RESEARCH_ORGANS_CURRENT_MAIN_REBASE_PASS=1
